scope: Seven explicit four-timestamp Filter guards and sample-admission boundaries, checked by the unchanged native Clock assertion oracle. This finite campaign does not establish full Clock mutation coverage or independent feasibility of every short-circuit operand.

mutations.before: !synchronized || precision == 0 || precision > 20'000'000 || uncertainty > clockUncertaintyLimitNanoseconds || t0 > limit || t1 > limit || t2 > limit || t3 < 0 || t0 > static_cast<std::uint64_t>(t3) || t2 < t1
mutations.after: (!synchronized || precision == 0 || precision > 20'000'000 || uncertainty > clockUncertaintyLimitNanoseconds || t0 > limit || t1 > limit || t2 > limit || t3 < 0 || t0 > static_cast<std::uint64_t>(t3) || t2 < t1) && false
